overview.description: The Eventide Small Cap ETF (ESSC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund provides exposure to small-cap US companies. The actively managed fund selects equity securities using fundamental research that includes a values-based screening inspired by the Christian faith. ESSC was launched on Sep 29, 2025 and is issued by Eventide.
